question: Does complicated behavior settle into a predictable pattern?
idea: Individual cases may vary, yet their behavior can approach a fixed value or distribution as a parameter grows. The exact kind of limit, and the conditions under which it is claimed, are part of the statement below.
why: The study of limits, functions, and change. It asks whether approximations converge and how accurately quantities can be estimated.
exactClaim: Proves maximal and annular r-variation bounds, for every r > 2, from complex $L^3(\mathbb R^2)\times L^3(\mathbb R^2)$ to $L^{3/2}(\mathbb R^2)$. The maximal estimate controls both hard truncation endpoints and gives almost-everywhere and norm convergence. Pairing with a third input settles the triangular Hilbert transform estimate at the symmetric $L^3\times L^3\times L^3$ point.
scope: A definition-led reading guide; the exact mathematical claim is preserved separately. This is not a proof assessment.
